note:
1891 households from the nine census pages A. Hagues sent, whose address this record cannot place. Deliberately NOT named people_*.json, so the importer never reads it.

THIS FILE WAS REWRITTEN. Its first version listed addresses that appear on no image — the whole of Pelham Crescent, Weston Lodge, 41 Lenton Road, Linde House on South Road, Parkmount on Park Drive, Pelham Cottages, Thorn Lea, and a Lincoln Villa at 11 Pelham Crescent. Those were written up in error and are struck. Every entry below has been checked against the image it came from.

Two kinds. First, numbered addresses on streets the record holds at numbers it does not — these look like real Park houses simply missing. Second, house names with no number.
source: 1891 census — nine enumerator's pages transcribed by A. Hagues, each entry checked against the image
